CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 12.5
   C. 6
   D. 25

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 22
   C. 36
   D. 18

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

5. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 105
   C. 44
   D. 30

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

9. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

10. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

12. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

15. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

16. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
